title: Indiana couple withhold home payment over construction defects, lose appeal against builder
summary_full: An Indiana couple withheld the remaining payment for a $211,235 modular home, citing construction problems. The Indiana Court of Appeals upheld a $221,704 judgment against them, finding that the builder had substantially performed its contractual obligations and that the couple had prevented it from completing the remaining work.
